acceptance.formula: F(theta)-F* <= ||gradient in original feature coordinates||_2^2/(2*ridge), since the objective is ridge-strongly-convex. This is a numerical gradient-based bound, not interval-arithmetic certification.

audit: Compare the conditioned solution and mapped original coefficients on all training predictions; evaluate the original-coordinate gradient independently and check the transformation. Report every termination, objective, gradient, bound, call count, label exposures and fixed endpoint even if the bound fails.
centering: Subtract each variant feature mean fitted on training only. Regularization is defined on coefficients of these centered features and the learned intercept.
condition: Full untruncated eigendecomposition C=Q diag(d) Q^T of training covariance. Transform phi to (phi-mean) Q diag(1/sqrt(max(d,0)+ridge)). This is invertible; no motor or covariance direction is selected or removed.
data: Reuse exactly the same fixed training D4 views, natural validation subset and opening-family split. No test labels or new core extraction. This is a validation-informed diagnostic on reused banks, not fresh independent confirmation.
features: Same raw individual motor bank as motor-learnability-v1, before readout gains. Training-only normalization with its fixed 1e-6 floor; gated keeps the same at most 128 largest positive standardized deviations. Bias-only adds an action-bias residual over the original policy.
followup: If a sufficiently converged decoder generalizes much better than bias-only, qualify its conditioning for end-to-end training. If converged training loss or held-out fit remains poor, examine attenuation from incoming-strength averaging before a separately registered propagation study. Do not infer missing information from a nonconverged or overfit fit.
initialization: Zero residual coefficients, reproducing the frozen original logits for every case.
name: motor-convergence-v1
objective: Mean raw-teacher legal-policy cross entropy + ridge/2*(squared Frobenius norm of original centered-feature coefficients + squared intercept norm). Original logits, value and circuit remain fixed. FP64 analytic derivatives include actual target mass.
scope: 27 frozen-core policy fits; no recurrent-rule changes, value optimization, new topology, playing-strength claim or CNN budget comparison. Count all solver label passes separately from prior core exposures. No TPU initialization.
